create_mlp_classifier: create an MLP classifier with configurable linear, batchnorm, relu, and dropout layers
build_mlp_layers: build a sequence of linear, batchnorm, relu, and dropout layers from dimension specifications
create_mlp_fsdp_head: create an FSDP-wrapped MLP model head with automatic batch norm wrapping
scale_mlp_weights: scale MLP linear layer weights and biases by a configurable multiplier
forward_mlp_input: forward a 2D or 4D tensor through the MLP classifier and return 2D output
